title_zh: 山东省烟台市原一级巡视员杨洪旭接受审查调查
title_en: Former Yantai Inspector Yang Hongxu under Investigation
summary_zh: 8月13日，据山东省纪委监委消息，烟台市原一级巡视员杨洪旭涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
summary_en: On August 13, Yang Hongxu, former first-level inspector of Yantai, Shandong, is under disciplinary review and supervisory investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law, according to the Shandong Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision.
body_zh:
中新网8月13日电 据山东省纪委监委消息：山东省烟台市原一级巡视员杨洪旭涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受山东省纪委监委纪律审查和监察调查。
